messages.subject: Status for this week's lab meeting
messages.body: Hi — before Thursday's meeting, can you send a short status on the yield-prediction project? I want the current model accuracy, what changed since last week, and any blockers. Keep it to a paragraph.

messages.subject: Quote #Q-5582 — 20x BME680 gas sensors
messages.body: Thank you for your enquiry. 20 units of the BME680 are NT$248 each, NT$4,960 total, ex-tax. Lead time 2 weeks. This quote is valid for 30 days.

messages.subject: INTERNAL ONLY: remaining Q3 equipment budget
messages.body: For your planning only, please do not forward: the lab has NT$61,300 left in the Q3 equipment budget. The sensor order below is fine to proceed.

messages.subject: Reminder: Lab meeting Thursday 14:00
messages.body: You have 'Weekly lab meeting' on Thursday 2026-07-30 at 14:00 in Room 6F-A. Agenda: project status round-robin.

messages.subject: Your weekly arXiv digest: 6 new papers
messages.body: New this week in your follow list: efficient on-device inference, sensor fusion for anomaly detection, and four others. Open the digest to see abstracts.

messages.subject: Re: dataset split for yield model
messages.body: I re-ran the split you asked about. Using the stratified 80/10/10 split, validation accuracy came out at 0.912, up from 0.87. Pushed the notebook to the shared drive.

messages.subject: Call for papers: IoT & Edge AI workshop
messages.body: Submissions for the autumn IoT & Edge AI workshop close September 15. Consider submitting your yield-prediction work.
